messages:
Ana R.: Heads up — SummitBridge Capital (sec contact: natalie.s@summitbridge.com) needs our SOC 2 Type II for vendor review. They also want a mutual NDA before we send anything. POC kickoff next Wed, can we move on this today?

Kai M.: Thanks Ana. They asked specifically for a redacted report + a short bridge letter stating our POC incident notification window. They want something presentable to their risk committee today.

Jordan L. (Legal): We can do a redacted SOC2 PDF + a mutual NDA template. I can also draft a bridge letter (limited assurance) that references incident notification to a named security contact. Standard turnaround 24-48h if we have signer details.

Evan S. (Security): For hosted POC we can include: at-rest AES-256, KMS with yearly rotation (customer-managed keys possible for Dedicated), logging retention policy (configurable for POC). We'll redact other customers from the report.

Leah G.: Quick Q re POC env: do they want Dedicated or Hosted? That changes what we include about network isolation / customer-managed KMS.

Ana R.: Hosted for now, but they reserved the right to request Dedicated during POC. Security contact says they need the redacted report + bridge letter to approve environment access.

Jordan L. (Legal): OK. Please confirm signer full name and company address. Once they sign we can countersign same day and release the redacted PDF. If they need a placeholder faster, I can issue a Bridge Letter with the caveat that full SOC2 will follow post-NDA.

Kai M.: I'll ask Natalie for signer details and the email for their security ops.

Natalie S. (SummitBridge): (via DM) Hi team — signer is Michael H., SummitBridge Capital, 20 Montgomery St, Suite 1600, San Francisco CA 94104. Security contact is secops@summitbridge.com. Can you include a line that notifications will go to that address?

Jordan L. (Legal): Yes. Bridge Letter will include: "Notifications will be sent to the customer's designated security contact(s) and include an initial summary and follow-up remediation plan."

Evan S. (Security): One operational note: for hosted POC we'll set log retention to 30 days and mask token prefixes by default. KV cache can be disabled for the POC but expect higher latency. I'll add that to the one-pager.

Ana R.: SummitBridge asked if the redacted PDF will show the auditor name and scope (infra + application). Is that OK to leave visible?

Evan S. (Security): Auditor and scope are fine on cover page; we only redact customer-identifying material and internal contact emails.

ops-bot: export ready: https://redwood-internal.s3/exports/soc2/summitbridge-redacted-2026-06.pdf (access: legal,sales,security)

Jordan L. (Legal): Uploaded NDA + Bridge Letter to DocuSign. I'll include the redacted report link in the package. I can expedite countersignature once they sign.

Kai M.: Natalie, please sign when you get the DocuSign link. If they sign now we can get the executed copy over within hours.

Natalie S. (SummitBridge): Signed. Please send the executed NDA and the redacted SOC2 link to secops@summitbridge.com. Also — can you provide a one-slide controls summary we can attach to the vendor questionnaire?

Leah G.: I have a 1-slide controls summary template (auth, KMS, network isolation, logging/retention, incident response). I'll tailor it for SummitBridge and post it here in ~45m.

Jordan L. (Legal): Countersigned and emailed executed NDA + bridge letter + redacted SOC2 link to secops@summitbridge.com. Included the 72-hour incident notification clause for POC. If they ask for 48h, we need security signoff — 48h is possible for high-severity events only.

Evan S. (Security): We can agree to 48h initial notification for critical incidents during POC with the caveat that detection time varies. Added that language to the bridge letter as an optional clause.

Kai M.: Closing loop — SummitBridge confirmed receipt and their risk team is happy to proceed with hosted POC. If they request Dedicated we will update the controls matrix and escalate for architecture review.

Ana R.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the opportunity and attach the executed docs. Reopen thread if SummitBridge requests unredacted sections (we'll need signed NDA).
